title: Wish for Automation
symptom: The user wants to compensate for slight fluctuations in basal rate (2-10%) by temporarily increasing basal rate by 20% and then resetting it, but the automation requires selecting a defined basal rate for the cancellation rule, which is inconvenient. They request the ability to select a defined basal rate in the automation rule and to integrate the cancellation rule into the actual automation.
evidence_quote: I increase the BR for a short time by 20% and then reset it to the original BR with another cancellation rule. And here is part of my problem because you always have to select a defined BR for the cancellation rule.
